decisions.reason: Changing the visual reference sites does not alter the requirement for a mobile-friendly experience.
The client requests closer visual resemblance to reference sites but does not change the SMASH ROOM name, logo, colors, or branding rules.
The new design references do not change the requirement for dedicated location pages or cross-location consistency.
The source changes visual design references but does not change the reusable-template strategy, future-location support, or Seattle template basis.
Visual reference-site selection does not alter the Wix booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation rules.
The source does not change location-selector behavior, location options, or routing destinations.
Changing the design references does not alter the master site's national role or its separation from location-site booking.
The source contains no change to location packages or prices.
Visual design references do not change the separate Wix-site and Wix-account architecture.
The source does not affect isolation of bookings, revenue, customer data, analytics, memberships, or staff access.
The client changes the visual reference sites but does not add, remove, or reorder any required homepage section.
The source does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, required page sections, button label, or opening transition.
